title: Microsoft PowerToys adds CursorHide, Button Lock mouse tools
description: Microsoft PowerToys 0.102 introduces two new mouse utilities, CursorHide and Mouse Button Lock, along with command-line tools and Command Palette enhancements. CursorHide automatically hides the mouse pointer while typing or when the mouse is idle. Mouse Button Lock allows users to lock a mouse button virtually, facilitating dragging or selection without holding the button physically. These features aim to improve usability, accessibility, and productivity. There is no indication of any security vulnerability or threat associated with these new features.
aiSummary: Microsoft released PowerToys version 0.102, adding two new mouse utilities: Mouse Button Lock, which lets users lock a mouse button virtually to ease dragging and selection tasks, and CursorHide, which hides the mouse pointer automatically while typing or when idle. Additional improvements include a quick-access shelf for the Command Palette and new command-line scripting tools. These updates enhance user experience and accessibility but do not introduce any known security vulnerabilities or exploits.
aiImpact: No security impact or vulnerability is described or implied in the provided information. The update focuses on usability and accessibility improvements without introducing exploitable flaws.
